description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Fetcher, which is a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor used in the 'git svn fetch' process to handle Subversion tree delta callbacks. It includes methods for managing files, directories, properties, and deltas, and maintains internal state about the repository. The code facilitates integration of Subversion changes into Git by recording changes in a specialized format.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor implementing callbacks to process Subversion tree deltas for git-svn integration, handling files, directories, properties, and deltas to reflect SVN changes into git repositories.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a Git::SVN::Fetcher object with configuration and state related to the repository and SVN options.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Starts processing at the root directory, returning a hash with the path key.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Handles opening of a directory at a given path, returning a hash with directory info.

methods.name: git_path
methods.description: Converts a given repository-relative path into a Git-compatible path, applying pathname encoding and optional path stripping.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Handles deletion of a file or directory at the specified path, updating internal states and possibly removing associated index entries.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Opens a file at a path, retrieving its mode and blob info from SVN, and preparing for delta application.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Records the addition of a new file, setting appropriate mode and tracking.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Records the addition of a directory, and handles placeholder files if needed.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Records a change to a directory property.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Marks a directory as absent (could not be conveyed).

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Marks a file as absent (could not be conveyed).

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Records changes to a file property, including executable or special modes.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Prepares to apply a text delta to a file, setting up temporary files and handling checksum verification.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Finalizes the application of a delta to a file, computes the object hash, and updates internal index accordingly.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Handles cleanup if an edit operation is aborted.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the edit, handling empty directories, placeholder files, and committing changes.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Identifies directories that have become empty after deletions.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Adds a placeholder file in an empty directory.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Stores the list of placeholder files in SVN config for persistence.
